shortDescription: JD LOGISTICS HKEX:2618 announced its results for the third quarter ended September 2026. Revenue added 16.1% YoY to RMB63.953 billion. Net profit dropped 16% YoY to RMB1.705 billion. Non-IFRS profit hiked 7% YoY to RMB2.16 billion. Non-IFRS EBITDA grew 10.6% YoY to RMB5.881 billion.
